SimpleAttackRolls.Name: Simple Attack Rolls
SimpleAttackRolls.Hint: Changes the default weapon automation behaviour to disabled. Attack rolls will trigger a Weapon Skill or Ballistic Skill roll as needed.

SimplePsychicRolls.Name: Simple Psychic Rolls
SimplePsychicRolls.Hint: Changes the default psychic power automation behaviour to disabled. Psychic rolls will trigger a simple Willpower roll.

AutoPsychicPhenomena.Name: Auto-roll Psychic Phenomena
AutoPsychicPhenomena.Hint: When a psychic power triggers phenomena (per PR sufficiency and doubles rules), automatically draw from the Psychic Phenomena roll table. A draw of 75+ auto-cascades to the Perils of the Warp table. Disable to let the GM draw manually via the sheet buttons.

PrimaryGameSystem.Name: Primary Game System
PrimaryGameSystem.Hint: The 40K RPG line this world runs. Sets the default line for newly-created actors and the active line used to resolve homologated content viewed outside an actor (e.g. compendium items).

DH2Ruleset.Name: DH2e Economy Ruleset
DH2Ruleset.Hint: RAW uses only Influence + Requisition (Throne Gelt hidden). Homebrew adds Throne Gelt as street-level currency and keeps Influence at 0 until earned (no starting roll).

ResyncOnReady.Name: Hydrate Embedded Items From Compendiums on World Boot
ResyncOnReady.Hint: On every world load, join each embedded item's canonical body (description, mechanics, classification) from its compendium source IN MEMORY — no database write, so stored records stay lean and per-actor state (skill advances, ammo counts, equipped flags, modifications, quantities, XP cost) is never touched. A compendium edit propagates to every actor on the next load. Disabling this leaves items lean until their sheet is next opened (sheets always hydrate on render).

ReconcileOriginGrantsOnReady.Name: Reconcile Origin-Path Grants on World Boot
ReconcileOriginGrantsOnReady.Hint: On every world load (GM only), re-apply each actor's embedded origin paths idempotently so missing trained-skill grants self-heal without re-running character creation. Characteristic/wounds/fate contributions are reconciled against a recorded per-origin delta (no double-counting); skills, talents, and the origin item itself are skip-if-exists. Safe to run every boot.

WarbandSubtlety.Name: Warband Subtlety Pool
WarbandSubtlety.Hint: The single warband-wide Subtlety value (DH2) shared by every acolyte. Edited from any acolyte's Subtlety stepper rather than this menu; changing it updates the shared pool and re-renders all open character sheets.

WorldTimeInception.Name: Campaign Inception (World Time)
WorldTimeInception.Hint: The world-time stamp, in seconds, treated as Day 0 for the day-since-inception counter. Day 0 is the campaign/mission inception and is fixed once at campaign start — it is not re-anchorable from the world-time widget.

CampaignInceptionDate.Name: Campaign Inception Date (Imperial)
CampaignInceptionDate.Hint: The campaign's inception as a canonical Imperial timestamp — check.fraction.year.millennium, e.g. 5.420.816.M41. This IS Day 0; the world-time widget renders this date advanced by elapsed in-universe time.

DegreesMode.Name: Degrees of Success Calculation
DegreesMode.Hint: How degrees of success/failure are counted. RAW resolves per game system. Gen 1 (DH1, Deathwatch, Rogue Trader): one extra degree per full 10 points of margin — floor(|target − roll| / 10). Gen 2 (Black Crusade, Only War, Dark Heresy 2e): 1 + the difference of the tens digits.

FatigueMode.Name: Fatigue Model
FatigueMode.Hint: Which fatigue mechanic to use. Auto follows each game line's RAW rules: Halving (Dark Heresy 1e/2e) — a characteristic whose bonus is below the fatigue level counts as half its value, threshold is Toughness + Willpower bonus, death at double threshold. Flat (Rogue Trader, Deathwatch, Only War, Black Crusade) — a single −10 to all tests for any fatigue, threshold is Toughness bonus. Condition (Imperium Maledictum) — a two-tier Fatigued condition (Minor: Disadvantage; Major: all tests Very Hard). Choosing a specific model forces it for every actor regardless of game line.

Choices.Halving: Halving — fatigued characteristics count as half (DH1/DH2)
Choices.Flat: Flat — −10 to all tests while fatigued (RT/DW/OW/BC)

PromptIncompleteOriginPath.Name: Prompt to Build Unfinished Characters
PromptIncompleteOriginPath.Hint: When a character or NPC sheet is opened and its origin path has never been completed, show a prompt offering to open the origin-path builder. Players can dismiss it per-character.

RollKeepModes.Name: Advantage, Disadvantage & Emphasis Rolls
RollKeepModes.Hint: When enabled, the roll dialog lets a test be rolled with Advantage (roll the d100 twice, keep the lower), Disadvantage (roll twice, keep the higher) or Emphasis (roll twice, keep the result furthest from 50 — more extreme either way). The chat card shows both dice. When disabled (default), tests roll one d100 as in the rulebooks.

HomebrewSelfTargeting.Name: Homebrew Self-Targeting
HomebrewSelfTargeting.Hint: When enabled, targeting yourself in an attack or roll uses the homebrew treatment: point-blank range, and the enemy-defence situational modifiers (target size, cover, target state) are skipped because they do not apply to yourself. When disabled (default), self-targeting follows the rulebook.

AutoCoverLos.Name: Auto Line of Sight & Cover
AutoCoverLos.Hint: When enabled, the attack dialog ray-casts from the attacker to the target against the scene's walls to auto-detect line of sight and full/half cover, and pre-selects the cover situational. Low cover marked on a scene (tables, pews, rubble from Zephyr Cartography maps) near the target also counts as cover without blocking sight. Disabled by default: verify the geometry on your own scenes before relying on it to drive rolls.

AwarenessSenseSplit.Name: Homebrew: Awareness Sense Channels
AwarenessSenseSplit.Hint: When enabled, Awareness resolves per sense channel (Visual / Auditory / Olfactory): the test-variant selector is offered for skills that declare channels even outside the homebrew ruleset, sense-scoped modifiers apply to their channel only (an auspex bonus tagged Visual augments sight, not hearing), and a condition that blinds or deafens auto-fails the matching channel. Disabled by default: Awareness rolls exactly as written, with the auspex bonus applying to the whole test.

FreeformCharacters.Name: Freeform Character Editing
FreeformCharacters.Hint: When enabled, content items (special abilities, malignancies, mutations, mental disorders) and world origin paths can be edited directly in Foundry, and items such as origin paths may be dragged onto an actor to build a character outside the Origin Path Builder. When disabled (default), these surfaces are read-only and the builder is the supported path. To make changes that persist across worlds and updates, edit the source in its compendium instead.

FreeformCreation.Name: Freeform Talent and Trait Creation
FreeformCreation.Hint: When enabled, the drop-to-add zone on the Talents and Traits panels is shown, allowing talents and traits to be added by dragging them onto a character sheet. When disabled (default), the dropzone is hidden and talents and traits must be granted through the advancement and XP flow.

FreeformItems.Name: Freeform Item Editing
FreeformItems.Hint: When enabled, equipment item sheets (weapons, armour, gear, ammunition, cybernetics, and other gear) can be edited directly in Foundry, allowing in-world item creation and tweaks. When disabled (default), these surfaces are read-only. To make changes that persist across worlds and updates, edit the source in its compendium instead.

MovementAutomation.Name: Movement Automation
MovementAutomation.Hint: Controls whether token movement enforces character movement speeds via the ruler.

CharacteristicOffset.Name: Characteristic Offset
CharacteristicOffset.Hint: Integer added to the characteristic base of 25 used during character generation. Effective base = 25 + offset. May be negative.

PointBuyPool.Name: Point-Buy Pool
PointBuyPool.Hint: Total points a player may spend in point-buy character generation. Each +1 above a characteristic's base costs 1 point. Defaults to 60.

MultipleFateBurnPerRoll.Name: Multiple Fate Burn Per Roll (Homebrew)
MultipleFateBurnPerRoll.Hint: Allow spending more than one Fate Point on the same roll (e.g., re-roll AND add a Degree of Success). RAW (Dark Heresy 2e) permits only one Fate spend per Test.

AutoRollDamage.Name: Auto-roll Damage on Hit
AutoRollDamage.Hint: When a weapon or psychic attack succeeds, automatically roll its damage and post the damage card. Disable to require clicking the chat "Roll Damage" button manually.

AutoApplyDamage.Name: Auto-apply Damage to Target
AutoApplyDamage.Hint: When a GM resolves a damage roll made against a selected target, automatically apply the reduced damage (armour by hit location + Toughness Bonus) to the target's wounds — rolling critical damage and applying its status on overflow — instead of clicking the chat "Assign Damage" button. Player-rolled attacks still apply via the button. Defaults to off.

RequireCombatToAttack.Name: Require Active Combat to Attack
RequireCombatToAttack.Hint: When enabled, weapon attacks can only be initiated during an active combat encounter that the attacker's token is part of. Disable for out-of-combat or narrative attacks. Defaults to on.

MagazineBuilding.Name: Enable Magazine Building
MagazineBuilding.Hint: When enabled, the weapon sheet shows a Build Clip action that lets players compose an ordered mixed magazine — loading several ammunition types in firing order (e.g. 3 AP then 2 Hot-shot). RAW loads one ammo type per clip, so this is off by default; the standard Reload is unaffected either way.

DeathLootPiles.Name: Dead tokens become lootable piles
DeathLootPiles.Hint: When a creature gains the Dead status, drop its carried gear as an Item Piles pile at its token, so the party can loot the body without the GM hand-building a container. Requires the Item Piles module. Intrinsic items (talents, traits, skills, powers) and bound items such as the default Unarmed strike are never transferred.

NpcAdvancement.Name: NPCs advance like characters
NpcAdvancement.Hint: Treat every NPC as a buildable character rather than a frozen stat block. Its printed characteristics are split into purchasable advances, its aptitudes are derived from the skills, talents and characteristics it actually has, and its experience at spawn is set to the exact XP those advances would cost — so the Advancement Dialog can keep advancing it from there. Off by default; enabling it changes no printed value, only how the stat block is accounted for.

Description.EvasiveManoeuvring: Driver makes an Operate test; on success, attackers suffer a -10 penalty to hit the vehicle until the start of the driver's next turn.
Description.FloorIt: Vehicle moves at maximum tactical speed in a straight line; all ranged attacks against the vehicle suffer a -10 penalty, but the driver may take no other actions this turn.
Description.HitAndRun: Vehicle moves up to its tactical speed, gunners may fire as a free action during the move, then the vehicle continues to its end position.
Description.Jink: Reaction: driver attempts an Operate test against an incoming attack; on success the attack suffers a -20 penalty to hit.
Description.TacticalManoeuvring: Vehicle moves at tactical speed and may make a single course change of up to 90 degrees during the move.

Description.Charge: Mount and rider close to melee on a charge; the rider strikes with +10 WS, and Brutal Charge mounts add a further +20.
Description.Trample: Mount drives over an enemy in its path; resolve impact damage from the mount's profile against the target's armour and TB.
Description.RunDown: Mount pursues a fleeing target at full pace; the target must outpace the mount's Agility-based movement or be overrun.
Description.MountedAttack: Rider attacks from the saddle as a Half Action, combining situational mount-trait modifiers with the weapon-skill test.

CelestialBody.Hint: Drive this scene's darkness from the body's local time of day and current weather as the world clock advances. Leave unset for interiors, voidships and hand-lit maps.

Latitude.Label: Latitude
Latitude.Hint: Where on its celestial body this scene lies, from −90 (south pole) to 90 (north pole). With a body bound, the sun's place in the sky follows the body's hour, season and axial tilt, and drop shadows fall away from it. Leave empty to keep the map's own sun.
